I booked and travelled specifically for a HIFU treatment, with extensive WhatsApp communication prior to the appointment confirming the treatment, pricing, and booking details. Everything was booked, confirmed, and ready to go.

After spending over an hour each way and 1,400 baht on taxis, I arrived expecting to proceed with the treatment I had clearly booked.

Instead, a non-medical staff member pushed a brochure in front of me and told me I “needed” Oligio, priced at around four times the cost, with no explanation as to why the treatment I booked was suddenly unsuitable.

When I asked for a doctor’s explanation or medical opinion, I was told I would need to pay an additional 1,000 baht just to speak to the doctor — effectively charging me to justify an upsell that the clinic itself initiated.

At no point did anyone:
•	Explain the clinical reasoning for changing the booked treatment
•	Offer a medical consultation as part of that decision
•	Acknowledge or apologise for the wasted time and travel costs
•	Attempt to resolve the situation

The follow-up communication avoided addressing these issues entirely.

Despite clear pre-booking communication and confirmation, this experience felt like a bait-and-switch and cash-grab, not a patient-first medical consultation. Informed consent and transparent medical advice should come before sales tactics — not behind a paywall.

I would strongly advise others to clarify in writing whether:
•	The booked treatment will actually be honoured
•	A doctor consultation is required to proceed
•	And whether additional fees apply simply to receive an explanation

I’ve been using this clinic for over a year and never had any major issues—until recently. Unfortunately, the way I was treated in the last two visits was absolutely unacceptable, and I feel I can no longer stay silent.

The first situation involved my mother, who was visiting from abroad and doesn’t speak English. I made an appointment in her name, clearly informing the clinic in advance that she would only be on the island for a short time and that all procedures needed to be completed within seven days. The clinic confirmed the booking, and we showed up for the consultation. We waited a long time to see the doctor, and once we did, I joined as a translator. The doctor kindly explained everything and agreed to the procedures.

However, after leaving the office, we were told by the reception that none of the procedures could be done until a month later, as the doctor was leaving for Bangkok the same day and wouldn’t return for weeks. Not only did they waste our time, but they also tried to charge us for the consultation—despite knowing upfront that timing was critical. If we had been informed earlier that the procedures couldn’t be done within a week, we wouldn’t have booked the appointment at all.

I could have let it go as a one-time mistake—until it happened again.

My boyfriend booked a treatment for me as a birthday gift, something I regularly do at the clinic. I came in without needing a consultation, just the procedure. First, I was told to wait 30 minutes, and then I was informed that none of the treatments could be done because the doctor decided not to see me. Why? Because she was “upset” about not being paid for my mother’s previous consultation—something that was their error in the first place.

Trying to explain the situation led nowhere. I clarified that this appointment was booked and paid for by my boyfriend, it was for me, and I’ve always paid for procedures before. But I was treated like someone trying to get away with something, even though we were the ones impacted by their scheduling mistake.

To make it worse, the doctor didn’t even stay in the clinic to speak with me. I requested to clarify things in person, only to be told she had “left” or was “unavailable.” No explanation. No accountability. Just laughter and mockery from the reception team as they brushed the whole situation off like a joke.

After an hour of frustration and wasted time, they offered me an IV vitamin drip as a “gift”—a gesture that didn’t come close to making up for the procedures I missed and the poor treatment I received.

It’s honestly hard to tell whether the issue lies with the doctor’s lack of professionalism or the reception team’s inability to communicate and manage bookings properly. Either way, after more than a year of being a loyal client, I feel completely disrespected. This is not how any clinic should treat people.

I just got fillers and botox by Dr Nam and her assistant Boum, they were both amazing and really listened to me. Both made sure to make me feel very comfortable and confident in the whole thing. My pain tolerance is quite low and Boum …

I don’t speak English, so my daughter was the one who helped arrange everything and came with me to the clinic as my interpreter. I was visiting the island only for a short time, and this clinic knew exactly when I was arriving and when I was leaving. We clearly explained that I had just one week to complete all of the procedures, and that was communicated to the clinic from the very beginning.

They booked my appointment anyway, and we went there with the full intention of doing everything—no hesitation. I was ready and happy to proceed with the treatments, even if it meant paying over 100,000 baht that same day. The doctor explained everything in detail, and we agreed to go ahead. But once we left the office, the reception casually told us that none of the procedures could be done at all—not that day, not even that week—because the doctor was leaving for Bangkok that same day and wouldn’t return for a month.

This was never mentioned when we booked the appointment, even though they knew from the start that I was flying out in just a few days. So instead of getting things done as planned, I was left with no time to find another clinic—because, as anyone knows, these kinds of treatments must be booked in advance. They completely wasted my time, caused me so much unnecessary stress, and left me with nothing but disappointment and frustration.

To make things worse, after all this confusion, they tried to make me pay for the consultation, even though the only reason we had the consultation in the first place was because they failed to inform us that the doctor wouldn’t be available to perform any of the procedures. If they had simply told us that from the start, we would have never come and could have looked for another option elsewhere.

This entire experience was deeply upsetting. I was left stressed, shaking, and heartbroken by how unprofessionally everything was handled. The clinic showed zero responsibility, no empathy, and not even the smallest apology. They made a huge mess and treated us like it was nothing.

I usually don’t write reviews, but this situation left me truly shocked.

I booked an appointment at this clinic for my girlfriend as a birthday gift—something she was really looking forward to. To make things worse, the reason they refused to proceed with the treatments was because the doctor apparently felt offended about not being paid for a previous consultation—one that wasn’t even for my girlfriend, but for her mother. That appointment was their mistake from the start: they knowingly booked a consultation when no procedures could be done in the necessary timeframe. It wasn’t our fault. And yet, somehow, they turned their own error into a personal issue and took it out on a loyal client.

The behavior was childish and completely unprofessional. They didn’t have the courage to speak directly to her about it—she was made to wait, then told by the reception that the doctor wouldn’t see her, and when she asked to speak in person, the doctor conveniently disappeared. No explanation, no responsibility.

After seeing how upset my girlfriend was, I tried calling the clinic to speak with someone and sort things out. They simply stopped answering the phone. They also ignored every message I sent. No apology, no response. Just complete silence, like a child hiding from their own mess.

I can’t believe a clinic operating on this island, one that we used to trust, would treat people this way—especially someone who’s been a regular, respectful client for over a year. They ruined what was supposed to be a thoughtful gift and a beautiful birthday. Absolutely unacceptable.
